description: This file declares functions related to manipulating HTTP request headers within a WebKit-based browser framework, including setting, removing, and applying headers for a given page.

methods.name: SetRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sets request headers for a given WKBundlePageRef, with WKTypeRef representing the headers.

methods.name: RemoveRequestHeaders
methods.description: Removes request headers for a specified WKBundlePageRef.

methods.name: ApplyRequestHeaders
methods.description: Applies request headers to a WKURLRequestRef associated with a page.
